lines.text: This is the cooling loop, seen from above.
Every 4SU pod carries its own CDU and pump at the wall end.
That pump sends hot water-glycol through the inner wall, where it disperses into the store.
64 pods put 50 MW of heat into the store this way.
Outside, every dry cooler has a pump of its own.
It draws liquid out of the store, cools it, and returns it cold at the outer wall.
The cold stream disperses as well. Nothing is piped straight from a cooler to a pod.
The store between them lets heat collection and heat rejection run independently.
